title: Western Springs maintains ISO Class 2 fire protection rating after evaluation
text:
Western Springs maintains ISO Class 2 fire protection rating after evaluation
Western Springs has maintained its Class 2 Public Protection Classification following a comprehensive evaluation by the Insurance Services Office, according to a July 15 announcement. The ISO evaluates community fire-protection systems and assigns ratings from Class 1 to Class 10.
Maintaining a Class 2 rating places Western Springs among the highest-rated communities nationwide for fire protection. The Village described this as an exceptional achievement in its media release.
Western Springs operates under a council-manager form of government, with policy-making separated from administration and public services delivered by professional staff supporting advisory boards, according to the official website. The village manager supervises personnel and implements policies set by the village president and board of trustees, who serve as elected volunteers. Resident volunteers also participate on boards and commissions that address community issues and provide recommendations, offering expert reviews on local matters.
Village offices are located at 740 Hillgrove Avenue in Western Springs, according to the official website.
